name: Suishou no Dragon
source:
The interstellar shuttle your friends were on has mysteriously disappeared, so you've flown out to
investigate. Before you can find them, however, you're attacked by a fiercely territorial dragon. You only survive thanks to the timely intervention of a crystal-eyed woman who warns you not to pull any more stunts.

So begins Crystal Dragon, over the course of which you'll pull basically
nothing BUT reckless stunts in an attempt to find out what happened to your friends.

[From [url=http://mute.vblank.net/snd.txt]Mute[/url]]
